assertions: Changing the capability set changes the application artifact cache key.
Changing the capability set changes the cross-source-snapshot cache index key.
Changing an effect assumption changes the application artifact cache key.
Changing an effect assumption changes the cross-source-snapshot cache index key.
coverage.scope: Compiler executable-artifact cache identity only. This proves changed authorization and effect assumptions cannot reuse the same application cache entries. It does not implement or claim Language verified-fact reuse.

claim_boundary: No source-language semantics or Language-owned identity system was added. Existing Compiler cache keys already include capabilities and effect assumptions; this regression test locks in invalidation for both the exact artifact entry and the cross-snapshot candidate index.
